# Pairfob

> Pairfob is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) phone and browser remote for the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok and others) running on your macOS or Linux computer. Sessions run in Herdr, which the installer sets up automatically. Pair once by QR code; no phone app required, no Pairfob account, no VPN, no inbound ports. An optional sideloaded Android beta is available. Sessions are end-to-end encrypted (direct WebRTC when possible, otherwise through the pairfob.com relay, which cannot read content).

Key facts:
- Host: macOS or Linux with Herdr 0.8+ (the installer automatically installs the latest stable Herdr if missing); the Herdr plugin route and agent inspection need Herdr 0.8.2+. Windows hosts: not supported.
- Client: any modern mobile browser (iOS Safari, Android Chrome); installable to the Home Screen as a PWA. No App Store app; the optional Android beta is a sideloaded APK.
- Same live session, not a copy: approve commands, reply (incl. dictation), review diffs, get "Needs you" push notifications.
- Agents: install and sign in to your chosen AI agent separately on the host; Pairfob does not install agents or configure their accounts. After pairing, Terminal works without an agent. A browser on the host itself can also pair.
- Live Demo (no install or pairing required): https://pairfob.com/demo (interactive sandbox with Chat/Control/real PTY Terminal, diff line comments, Board layout, and quota rings).
- Self-hosting: one-command Cloudflare Worker + Durable Objects + D1 deploy (`docs/selfhost.md`).
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://pairfob.com/install.sh | sh && pairfob pair`, then open https://pairfob.com/pair on the phone and scan. Or inside Herdr 0.8.2+: `herdr plugin install arronKler/pairfob`.
- Price: free. Source: https://github.com/arronKler/pairfob

## Docs
- [What it is](https://pairfob.com/doc/): concept and scope
- [Get started](https://pairfob.com/doc/start): install and first pairing
- [Pairing](https://pairfob.com/doc/pair): QR / 14-character code, admitting a device
- [FAQ](https://pairfob.com/doc/faq): security, relay, troubleshooting
- [Use cases](https://pairfob.com/doc/use-cases): control Claude Code, Codex and Grok from a phone; approvals, diffs, uploads; when Pairfob is not a fit
- [Android beta](https://pairfob.com/doc/android-beta): install, update and known limits for the optional sideloaded APK
